visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A 2D animated man and woman walk across a crosswalk at night. The woman has long black hair and a yellow bag, smiling at her companion. The man, in a black tank top, looks back at her while they hold hands. Street signs and a green walk signal are visible. (2) A blue truck speeds into frame. Inside, Shumei, wearing glasses and with grey hair, is frantically eating a bowl of noodles with chopsticks while driving. The background consists of grey city buildings and a shuttered storefront. (3) The scene cuts to a close-up of the couple's faces as they scream in panic, sweat beads on their foreheads. The background is dark with dramatic speed lines. A sudden crash is implied by the white flash. (4) In a white digital void, the couple appears as floating ghosts with white tails. A holographic blue screen titled "Heaven System Prompt" appears. The man's ghostly form looks confused as he stares at the text. (5) The man interacts with a complex character customization screen, showing various sliders and icons. The woman's ghost is seen in another screen, pressing a large "Confirm" button. The background remains a glowing digital landscape. (6) The man wakes up on a sunny beach with clear blue water and palm trees. His character model has changed significantly: he is now extremely muscular with a massive, square jaw and a broad grin. (7) The woman wakes up and reacts with horror at his change. Her own appearance has changed to include very large breasts. They stand on a sandy beach under a bright blue sky with white clouds and a blue umbrella. (8) The man gestures enthusiastically as the screen transitions to realistic 3D gameplay footage from "inZOI". Scenes show characters walking in urban areas, shopping, and high-quality beach environments with a sailboat and tropical huts. (9) A social media interface is displayed, showing a post by "Baxuan" and several physical prizes like cat-ear headphones and inZOI-branded boxes. The animated characters laugh together on the beach in the background while the logo appears.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, feminine voice asking about food, followed by a neutral, mid-range male response. The pace is conversational and relaxed. There is no background music, only subtle ambient city street noise floor. (2) A sudden, high-arousal engine roar and the sound of slurping noodles enter. A female voice speaks with high intensity and excitement, her tone exaggeratedly joyful as she describes the "satisfaction" of eating while driving. (3) High-pitched screams from both characters erupt simultaneously, followed immediately by a sharp percussive thud and the screeching of tires. The lack of music emphasizes the impact sound and the subsequent dramatic silence. (4) A calm, professional, and slightly synthetic female "system" voice begins speaking. The pitch is stable and the delivery is clearly enunciated. A soft, ambient digital drone providing a steady background layer is audible. (5) Mechanical clicking and digital chime SFX like dings and pops are layered as characters interact with the UI. The male voice's pitch rises in surprise as he discovers the various character customization features. (6) A transition whoosh leads into an energetic, high-tempo pop BGM with a strong rhythmic drum beat. The male voice's delivery becomes fast-paced and authoritative, shifting into a professional promotional narrative style for the game. (7) The BGM continues as sound effects like water splashes and sailboat movement are integrated during the game footage. The male voice remains high-energy, articulating clearly about Steam discounts and DLC features over the music. (8) The audio concludes with a group of characters laughing loudly with high vocal arousal. The BGM swells slightly before a final digital logo stinger sound effect marks the end of the promotional segment.
